name: Rascally Rodents

angles.text: As a human initiate training in Northshire Valley, you help defend the abbey’s treasures and books from pests and invaders.
As a priest aiding the Abbey of Northshire, you help protect the Holy Light’s scholars and their books from destruction.
As a mage, you know written knowledge is precious, even when kobolds threaten it.

faq.answer: Brother Paxton, a resident of the abbey in Northshire Valley, asks for help protecting its library from the kobolds.
faq.q: Who gives the quest Rascally Rodents?

faq.answer: Brother Paxton thinks the kobolds are eating his books, but the recovered volumes are untouched. Why the kobolds take and hoard them remains unknown.
faq.q: Why are the kobolds stealing books?

faq.answer: You find the Stolen Books among the kobolds in Northshire Valley, in their camps and mine workings.
faq.q: Where do you find the Stolen Books?

faq.answer: Brother Paxton belongs to the Northshire brotherhood and cares deeply for the abbey’s books. He relies on passing initiates to recover them from scavengers.
When you return eight stolen volumes, Brother Paxton gives you one of his how-to books, which he says he does not need. Many volumes remain missing.
faq.q: What does Brother Paxton give you as a reward?

faq.answer: No. Brother Paxton says many volumes are still missing from the valley, and the kobolds’ interest in them remains unexplained.
faq.q: Are all the stolen books recovered?

sections.body: Brother Paxton fears the kobolds that have spread from the hills and mines into Northshire Valley’s sacred grounds. He believes they are devouring books from his collection. With the library at risk, he asks young adventurers to hunt the kobolds and recover whatever volumes they can.
sections.title: A Threat to the Library

sections.body: Brother Paxton finds that the eight recovered volumes have not been eaten. The kobolds took and hoarded the books for reasons he cannot explain. Many volumes are still missing from the valley, and their strange interest in the books leaves him unsettled.
sections.title: An Unexplained Appetite

summary: Kobolds are carrying books away from Brother Paxton’s library in Northshire Valley. He fears they are devouring the abbey’s collection.
